text:
marta: FYI I rolled an L7 payload logging experiment on fw-cluster-eu at 03:07 to capture bodies for a compliance sample. Within minutes we hit KMS grant throttling during GPU node joins; many nodes couldn't unwrap /etc/keystore on boot.
raj: Ugh. I started seeing kubelet `Decrypt` failures and the autoscaler started throttling new nodes. Paste from the kubelet: 
```
Mar 23 03:09:41 kubelet[2567]: keystore decrypt failed: KMS ThrottlingException: GrantsPerSecondExceeded
Mar 23 03:09:41 kubelet[2567]: giving up after 4 retries
```
anika: Confirmed in metrics: keystore.decrypt.grants/sec jumped ~5x after the fw change. The audit pipeline has two modes; we flipped to direct ingestion for the test so each event triggered a decrypt. That created an amplification factor we didn't model.
sre_lead: Is the issue bounded to eu1? If the firewall aggregator path had been used it would've batched and reduced decrypts.
marta: It's primarily eu1. ap-south had a very small uplift but not problematic. I can revert the fw change immediately.
security_jen: We need to balance compliance richness vs availability. I recommend reverting to headers-only and enabling 10% sampling, then schedule a controlled rollout that uses the aggregator path.
raj: I'll run the revert and sampling commands now:
```
fwctl patch fw-cluster-eu --audit.l7_payload=false && fwctl set-audit-sample 0.1 --scope eu1
```
ops-bot: Triggering runbook keystore/mass-retry-onboard. Actions: drain failing nodes -> restart kubelet -> re-trigger cloud-init decrypt -> rejoin. ETA ~20m.
anika: After the revert node decrypt success rate increased from ~62% to ~97% within about 8 minutes. Autoscaler resumed.
sre_lead: Good. Action items: short-term: keep payload=false + 10% sampling in eu1 until midnight UTC. medium-term: change audit path to aggregator to ensure single decrypt per batch. long-term: request a KMS grant QPS bump for keystore service or add local grant caching with 30s TTL.
security_jen: I'll file the compliance exception for the temporary sampling window and track the date we plan to re-enable full payloads.
raj: Cost impact note: direct mode added S3 PUTs and KMS decrypts. Rough ballpark extra spend during the 40-minute window ~+15% in eu1. Add to incident cost sheet.
anika: Suggestion: add an automated safety rollback tied to keystore.decrypt.error_rate metric. If >4% for 2 consecutive minutes, flip payload off automatically. Could be a tiny lambda using alarm actions.
sre_lead: +1. Please make the alarm runbook-aware so we don't flip during planned tests.
marta: I'll create INFRA-1290 to track the guard, aggregator rollout, and the KMS quota request. Draft test plan attached in the ticket.
ops-bot: Incident logged: incident/1732109999 - "L7 payload audit caused KMS grant burst -> GPU node onboarding failures". Link to thread and runbook in incident doc.
security_jen: Owners: anika for RCA and remediation plan, raj for rollback automation and runbook updates, marta for rollout guard implementation. Compliance review scheduled for next Wednesday.
marta: Closing note: the rollback bought us stability quickly. No customer-facing errors observed, just slower node onboarding during the experiment. Thanks team :thumbsup:
